record.question: Who is the current Chief Justice of India?
record.explanation: Answer C: Sanjiv Khanna. Justice Sanjiv Khanna was Chief Justice of India at the February 2025 examination date. Reference: https://www.sci.gov.in/chief-justice-judges/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: LDC MPSC Paper-I, February 2025 examination; current affairs interpreted as of paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
